items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: So he -- Cuban Pete, I was so giggin' he took me on a gig.

ctx.x: You're one of the infidels. They can enslave do anything, they can slay you, they can beat you out of money, anything.

So he -- Cuban Pete, I was so giggin' he took me on a gig. One of the wine festivals. And (inaudible) says, I'm going to give you ten bills for this one. Room and board. Ten mill is the price for it. So we went to the West Coast of France, Bordeaux wine center. Get there and I'm happy and everything, the wine is so good that the wine give me pimples, the wine's so rich. And the food is so good.

But then it seems I went in the back room, to sort of rest myself, that wine was taking care of me. And I heard the man count five hundred, six hundred, seven hundred, eight hundred, nine hundred. (Inaudible).
